# Integration-readiness research: 100 apps

> For each of 100 SaaS and developer apps: auth methods, self-serve vs gated access, API surface, MCP, buildability verdict and the main blocker, each with an evidence URL and verbatim quote.

- [results.json](data/results.json): full records with per-field evidence
- [results.csv](data/results.csv): flat table
- [patterns.json](data/patterns.json): cross-app counts
- [human_labels.csv](data/human_labels.csv): hand-checked reference labels for the 20-app sample
- [accuracy.json](data/accuracy.json): measured accuracy per variant

Accuracy: see index.html. Hand-checked sample accuracy 92.0% on 199 fields (n=20 apps); values are claims with evidence, not guarantees.
